zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.40** 修复 rc.39 打包应用一启动就崩溃。正式版仍为 0.0.18。若本机数据已经写到协调格式 11，不要降回 rc.38。

zh.title: 修复与改进
items: 打包后的主进程找不到 `obligation-log.mjs`（#303，接 #297 / ADR 124）。electron-builder 会排除 `@peer-agent/*/src`，而 `obligation-log`、`execution-obligation`、`work-budget` 的子路径仍指向源码；`delegation-facts-reader` 还用仓库相对路径去加载 `diagnostic-phase`。这些入口改到 dist，和正在运行的模块是同一个实例。主进程能到达的导入都会打进 app.asar。PR CI 在打包前按文件列表做静态解析，缺文件即失败。

zh.title: 升级与验证范围
items: rc.39 一旦打开并写入义务跟进，协调数据可能已经是格式 11。这种数据不能降级到 rc.38。rc.40 继续读格式 11，也仍可读格式 9。更新前完整备份。Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 按同一版本说明升级。
本热修核对 macOS arm64 包的 `app.asar` 含 `obligation-log.mjs`，且主进程导入都能解析。不宣称界面手感已经复测。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.40** fixes the rc.39 packaged app crash on launch. Stable remains 0.0.18. If local data is already at coordination format 11, do not downgrade to rc.38.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: The packaged main process could not find `obligation-log.mjs` (#303, following #297 / ADR 124). electron-builder excludes `@peer-agent/*/src`, but the `obligation-log`, `execution-obligation`, and `work-budget` subpaths still pointed at source, and `delegation-facts-reader` loaded `diagnostic-phase` through a repository-relative path. Those entries now point at dist, the same module instance the running host uses. Every import reachable from the main process is included in app.asar. PR CI resolves that graph against the package file list and fails when a target is missing.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Once rc.39 has been opened and an obligation follow-up has been written, coordination data may already be format 11. That data must not be downgraded to rc.38. rc.40 still reads format 11 and can still read format 9. Keep a complete backup before updating. Upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI, and Gateway according to the same release instructions.
This hotfix checks that the macOS arm64 `app.asar` contains `obligation-log.mjs` and that every main-process import resolves. It does not claim the UI feel was retested. Stable remains 0.0.18.
